result.Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines and demands ransom for decryption; uses double-extortion by stealing data with RClone before encryption and threatening to leak data if ransom is not paid
result.Attack Vector: Initial access via spearphishing, purchase of access through Initial Access Brokers, malware from other groups (e.g., QakBot), exploitation of PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527) and Follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: Multiple AV signatures including W32/BlackBasta variants, ELF/BlackBasta variants, Linux/Filecoder_BlackBasta.A!tr, and others
Ransom notes directing victims to Tor .onion sites with Login ID
Black Basta Tor sites including communication and 'Basta News' leak site
File-based IOCs (hashes) listed in source content
